messages:
neal: Dry-run blocked for eu-west promotion: helm merge failed with CRD/values incompat in edgezone overlay. Need quick plan. cc @tara

tara: What failed? paste CI error.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: DRY-RUN FAILED
service auth-service: helm template failed: overlay 'edgezone' incompatible at key auth.providers (expected list, found map)
Command: helm upgrade --install auth-service ./charts/auth-service --dry-run --values values/eu.yaml --values overlays/edgezone.yaml
Logs: http://ci.internal/DRY-AUTH-77

neal: Overlay uses a map to name providers, upstream chart expects an array of provider entries. Auto-merge would rewrite semantics.

tara: Short term: pin chart to auth-service@0.9.7 and promote. Plan a hotpatch to migrate overlay shape and add a pre-merge check.

oncall: I'm online. Pin + canary sounds safe for the window.

ops-bot: k8s: recommend canary with 4 replicas for auth-service (steady-state 8) and a longer observation (30m) because auth has authz traffic spikes.

tara: I'll open a tiny PR to set chartVersion in overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml -> 0.9.7 and include a note to follow-up. Commands I'm using:
```
git checkout -b fix/edgezone-auth-pin
yq e '.resources[0].chartVersion = "0.9.7"' -i overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml
git add overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml && git commit -m "pin auth-service to 0.9.7 to avoid values/CRD shape mismatch" && git push origin fix/edgezone-auth-pin
```
Requesting review from @neal for visibility.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR merged. Kicking off canary auth-service@0.9.7 at 10% traffic. Canary id AUTH-77.

ops-bot: k8s: canary pods started: auth-eu-canary x4. Ready 4/4. Observing.

neal: Drafting release note: "Pinned auth-service chart to 0.9.7 to avoid values/CRD shape incompat with edgezone overlay. Follow-up hotpatch will migrate auth.providers to canonical array format and add CI validation."

ops-bot: canary metrics @20m: auth latency +1.2%, errors unchanged, user-login rate stable. No alerts.

tara: Bumping traffic to 40%. deploy-bot: route-canary AUTH-77 set-traffic 40%

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic updated to 40% for AUTH-77.

ops-bot: 40% steady at 15m: p95 unchanged, readiness 100%.

neal: No objections. Promote to 100% after another 10m if stable.

ops-bot: canary 50m overall: stable. No downstream authz errors observed.

tara: Promoting now. deploy-bot: promote AUTH-77

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted AUTH-77 to stable release auth-service@0.9.7. Notifying release-notes-bot.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: Added entry 2024-12-10: 'Pinned auth-service to 0.9.7 due to values/CRD shape incompat in edgezone overlay; migration hotpatch planned.'

neal: Rollback snippet for notes:
```
# rollback to previous release
prev=$(helm history auth-service -n prod | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $1}')
helm rollback auth-service $prev -n prod
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/auth-service
```
And ping #oncall if rollback triggered.

ops-bot: prod rollout complete. pods ready 8/8. No incidents.

neal: Closing thread after release notes link is posted. Follow-up ticket: infra add values-shape check (yq + schema) and schedule overlay migration.
